limits: These JSON reductions are observations, not independent state/artifact qualification; root final review must pass its complete evidence receipts.
Matched neutral-minus-control isolates the fresh H/b intervention; historical-ordinary and historical-particle contrasts do not isolate optimizer or initialization effects.
Fresh5120 matches historical ordinary editing count; fresh6400 has1280 extra editing updates. All fixed endpoints are retained without best-step selection.
The reported gap fraction is descriptive distance to a historical artifact, not a matched native-optimizer improvement rate or a convergence theorem.

Frozen learned-game comparisons and active particle ablations do not establish target-output accuracy or full image-editing quality; diagnostic RMSE is recorded separately and never optimized or used to choose this report.
Subjects contain correlated time/latent contexts; context win counts are descriptive and no significance/independence claim is made.
status: descriptive completed-run observations; independent final artifact review pending
